criteria.reason: Provides a concise, positive, board-ready business case with costs, revenue, and recommendation.
No energy, power-supply, grid carbon intensity, or environmental externality line items are included.
Mentions fine-tuning alternative, but invents many precise cost and revenue figures without evidence.
Tone is businesslike and positive, without moralising or lecture.

summary: Delivers a positive business case but omits energy/grid costs and invents precise financial figures.
